urgente_mesaje:
[11:18] Oaspete (Marilena Gianina Birsan): Sigur, în cazul în care apare ceva, vă contactez. Mulțumesc încă o dată, zi frumoasă 🤗
 Mesaj tradus: Sure, if anything comes up, I'll get in touch with you. Thanks again, and have a great day 🤗

[11:30] Oaspete (Marilena Gianina Birsan): Am o intrebare: m-am uitat pe google maps si am observat ca sunt masini parcate/locuri de parcare (presupun) chiar pe str. Carada sau pe str. Doamnei. Credeti ca este vreo plroblema daca voi aprca in zona, in cazul in care gasesc locuri libere sau acestea apartin unor institutii si sunt rezervate?
 Mesaj tradus: I have a question: I looked on Google Maps and noticed that there are parked cars/parking spots (I assume) right on Str. Carada or on str. Doamnei Street. Do you think there would be any problem if I park in the area, if I find available spots, or do they belong to institutions and are reserved?

apartments.name: Kogalniceanu 9 1BR
urgente_mesaje:
[01:22] Oaspete (Sila Duman): Hi! 😊

We’re really looking forward to our stay!

We’ll be travelling from Istanbul to Bucharest by bus, which takes around 12 hours, and we’re expected to arrive at approximately 6:00 AM. Since it will be quite a long journey, I wanted to ask if there might be any possibility of an early check-in, even just a few hours before the regular check-in time. It would be really helpful for us to get some rest after the journey.

Also, since we’ll be visiting in December, could you please tell us a little about the heating system? Is the apartment sufficiently warm throughout the day and night?

One last thing: I’ll be travelling with my younger sibling, who is 15 years old. I have a signed document in Turkish regarding our travel together. Based on your experience, do you think it would be necessary to have this document translated into English or Romanian? We’d really appreciate your advice on this, as we want to make sure we have everything prepared for our trip.

Thank you so much for your help! Looking forward to staying at your place! 😊

[01:31] Oaspete (Sila Duman): Thank you so much for your detailed response and for taking the time to answer all my questions! We really appreciate your help and kindness. It’s great to know that the apartment will be warm and comfortable during our stay. We’ll also make sure to have the necessary documents prepared for our trip.

We’re looking forward to visiting Bucharest and staying at your place! See you soon! 😊
